ex.s: However, race walking does not pound the body as much as running does, Dr Norberg says.
ex.t: 根据她的研究，跑步者每步着地时承受的重量可达体重的4倍，而不离地的竞走者每步只产生约1.4倍体重的压力。

ex.s: However, they can take up a lot of time, so students have to learn to organize their busy schedules.
ex.t: 然而，它们会占用大量时间，所以学生必须学会安排自己繁忙的日程。

ex.s: However, anyone 5_______ you bring must be over 12 years old.
ex.t: 但是，您携带的任何5 _______必须年满12岁。

ex.s: However, until recently no one knew how they did this.
ex.t: 然而，直到最近没有人知道他们是怎么做到的。

ex.s: The research on the monarch’s behaviour has however led to a greater awareness of this creature.
ex.t: 然而，对帝王蝶行为的研究促进了人们对这种生物的进一步认识。

ex.s: However, recent years have seen more and more unusual flavours come onto the market.
ex.t: 然而，近年来，市场上出现了越来越多不寻常的口味。
